references.text: Moses tells the people that the Lord will fight for them, and they shall be still. The same theme of God fighting for His people.
The Lord your God goes before you and will fight for you. A direct parallel in the same book.
The Lord your God goes with you to fight for you against your enemies. The same promise of God's battle for Israel.
The Lord fought for Israel. Fulfillment of the promise that God fights for His people.
The Lord your God is the one who fights for you, as He has promised. Joshua confirms the promise from Deuteronomy.
Do not be afraid, for I am with you. The same exhortation against fear with a promise of God's presence.
If God is for us, who can be against us? A New Testament parallel about God fighting on our side.
